senses.gloss:
mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छती-च्छत्)
Giving, presenting, bestowing.
E.
प्र before दा to give, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well-governed, restrained, self-subdued.
2 Careful, prudent.
m. (-तः)
A holy or pious person, one purified by austerity and mortification.
E.
प्र intensely, यत to endeavour, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone.
2 Removed, gone away or to a distance.
3 Deceased.
m. (-तः)
1 A name of BHṚGU.
2 A sleepy or lazy fellow.
E.
प्र before यत to endeavour, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Devout, pious, of a holy spirit.
E.
प्रयत, and आत्मन् soul.

n. (-त्नं)
1 Continued or persevering effort, exertion.
2 Act, action.
2 (In logic,) Active effort of three kinds, engaging in any act, prosecuting it, and completing it.
4 Caution, care.
5 Articulation of sounds.
E.
प्र intensitive, यत्न effort.

ind.
Particularly, especially, with especial effort, care or pains.
E.
प्रयत्न, and तसि aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Active, zealous, enterprising, assiduous, persevering.
E.
प्रयत्न effort, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-याः-याः-यः)
Valuable, precious.

ind.
1 Frequently, generally, for the most part.
2 Abundantly, largely.
E.
प्र before इण् or अय to go, aff. असुच्.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Seasoned, dressed with sauces and condiments.
E.
प्र before यस to take pains, and क्त aff.

m. (-गः)
1 Sacrifice, oblation.
2 A celebrated place of pilgrimage, the confluence of the Ganges and Jumna, with the supposed subterraneous addition of the Sarasvatī; the modern Allahabad. The term in composition is applied to many places of reputed sanctity, situated at the confluence of two rivers, as Deva-Prayāga, Rudra-Prayāga, Karṇa-Prayāga, and Nanda-Prayāga, in the Himāla mountains, which with Prayoga or Allahabad, constitute the five principal places so termed.
3 A name of INDRA.
4 A horse.
E.
प्र principal, यज to worship, and घञ् aff.; actual worship, or the place where worship is peculiarly efficacious; Allahabad is one of the places where BRAHMĀ is supposed to have consummated ten Aśvamedhas or sacrifices of the horse, in commemoration of his recovery of the four Vedas from ŚAṄKHĀSURA.

m. (-यः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
प्रयाग sacrifice, especially of the horse or Aśvamedha, and भय fear; INDRA being dethroned by the performance of a hundred such sacrifices.

m. (-जः)
1 A principal ceremony or sacrifice.
2 A part of a sacrifice.
E.
प्र before यज to sacrifice, aff. घञ्, form irr.

n. (-णं)
1 Going, motion.
2 Going forth or to a distance.
3 Departure.
4 Death.
5 March of an assailing force, attack, invasion.
E.
प्र before या to go, aff. ल्युट्; also with कन् added, प्रयाणक n. (-कं)

n. (-णं)
Death, voluntary death.
E.
प्र, and अयन going.

m. (-लः)
1 Time of departure.
2 Death.
E.
प्रयाण, and काल time.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Worthy of death.
E.
प्रयाण, and अर्ह fit for.

n. (-णं)
1 Sending, dispatching.
2 Expelling, driving away.
E.
प्र before या to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.; also न being unchanged, यापन.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be sent or sent away.
E.
प्र before या to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also प्रयापनीय.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Driven or sent away, made to go or pass away.
E.
प्र before या to go, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि)
Causing to go, who or what sends, or sends away, &c.
E.
प्र before या to go, causal v., णिनि aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being sent or made to go, pass away, &c.
E.
प्र before या to go, causal v., pass. v., शानच् aff.; also प्रयाप्यमान.

m. (-मः)
1 Checking, restraining.
2 Scarcity, dearth.
3 Competition of buyers in consequence of scarcity.
4 Length, either of space or time.
E.
प्र before यम to refrain, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-य्यं)
To be checked, controlled, &c.
E.
प्र before यम to check, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Trouble, labour, fatigue.
2 Desire for or pursuit of any object.
E.
प्र before यस to make exertion, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Capable of exertion or fatigue, active, energetic.
E.
प्रयास, and भाज् sharing.

mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्)
Going, about to go or depart.
E.
प्र before या to go, शतृ aff. to the fut. tense.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Endowed with, possessing as an attribute, &c.
2 Resulting from, consequential.
3 Appointed, nominated.
4 Associated or connected with.
5 Applied, employed.
6 Compact, closely united.
7 Done, to or for.
8 Abstracted, lost in meditation.
9 Lent, (as money.)
10 Asleep.
n. (-क्तं)
Cause.
E.
प्र before युज to join, aff. क्त.

f. (-क्तिः)
Occasion, cause, main object or end.
E.
प्र before युज to join, and क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-युक्)
Who or what joins or is connected with, literally or figuratively, as a cause, motive, &c.
E.
प्र before युज to join, क्विप् aff.

ind.
1 Having acted or behaved to or towards.
2 Having connected.
E.
प्र before युज to join, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being united or connected with.
2 Being used, employed, applied, &c.
E.
प्र before युज to join, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Adding, joining.
2 Using, employing.
3 Appointing, deputing.
4 Performing, doing.
E.
प्र before युज to join, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Joined, combined, united.
n. (-तं)
Ten hundred thousand, a million.
E.
प्र before यु to join, aff. क्त.

m. (-त्सुः)
1 A warrior.
2 A name of INDRA.
3 A name of the wind.
4 A ram.
5 An ascetic.
E.
प्र before युद्ध to contend, in the desiderative form, with उ aff.

n. (-द्धं)
War, battle.
E.
प्र before युद्ध the same.

m. (-र्थः)
War, battle, going to war or battle.
E.
प्र initiatory, युद्ध war, and अर्थ object.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Applicable, suitable, to be applied or employed.
E.
प्र before युज to unite, aff. तव्य.

m. (-गः)
1 Occasion, cause, motive, object.
2 Consequence, result.
3 Affair, matter.
4 Appointing, appointment.
5 Application, use, employment.
6 Ceremonial form, course of proceeding.
7 Magic, magical rites.
8 Subduing, fascinating.
9 Device, contrivance.
10 Example, comparison.
11 Act, action.
12 Dramatic action or performance^1.
13 Principal, loan bearing interest.
14 Lending money at interest.
15 Profits of usury or trade.
16 A horse.
17 Text, authority.
E.
प्र before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

ind.
1 According to or in consequence of.
2 Actually, in action.
E.
तसि added to प्रयोग.

m. (-र्थः)
Act, tending to a main object.
E.
प्रयोग aim or end, and अर्थ purpose.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Having some object in view, calculated for some particular purpose.
E.
प्रयोग object, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Who or what causes or induces any act.
2 Who or what deputes or appoints.
m. (-कः)
1 A founder or institutor of any ceremony.
2 A law-giver, a legislator.
E.
प्र before युज to join, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Acting as an instigator or promoter.
E.
प्रयोजक, and कर्त्तृत्व agency.

n. (-नं)
1 Cause, occasion.
2 Motive, origin.
3 Purpose, object, intention, design.
E.
प्र before युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Designing, purposing.
2 Having a cause, caused, produced.
E.
प्रयोजन, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Behaving to or towards, shewing, displaying.
2 Combining, &c.
E.
प्र before युज to join, aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
1 To be set to work, to be appointed or directed.
2 To be used, practised, employed, &c.
n. (-ज्यं)
Capital, principal.
m. (-ज्यः)
A servant, a slave.
E.
प्र before युज to join, aff. ण्यत्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Like, resembling, (used in composition.)
2 Exceeding, much.
m. (-यः)
1 Fasting to death, as a religious or penitentiary act, and especially after abandoning all worldly goods, and desires.
2 Quantity, abundance.
3 Death, dying.
4 A state or condition of life, age, youth, &c.
n. (-यं)
Sin.
E.
प्र before इन् to go, अच् aff.

ind.
Usually, commonly, for the most part.
E.
प्राय, and शसि aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Common, usual.
E.
प्राय, and ठक् aff.

m. (-त्तः)
Expiation, penance.
E.
प्राय sin, चित्त or चित्ति reflection, and सुट् aug. hence also प्रायश्चित्ति, f. (-त्तिः.)

f. (-धिः)
Rules for penance or expiation.
E.
प्रायश्चित्त, and विधि rite.

m. (-षी)
A horse.
E.
प्र mostly, आयुध a weapon, इप् to wish, aff. णिनि.

n. (-नं)
Fasting to death.
E.
प्राय, and उपवेशन sitting down.

f. (-का)
Sitting down to die by fasting.
E.
प्राय, उपवेश sitting down, कन् added, fem. form.
